diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3.3 V, datasheet reading 3.6 V
diffs.evidence: The 3.6 V figure is the 7Semi product page's conservative VIN rating, but the vendor's own wiring guide powers the board from the MCU's '| VCC        | 3.3V   | Sensor power |' and the BMI323 chip behind the onboard regulator runs from 'Wide power supply range: analog VDD 1.71 V ... 3.63 V', so a 3.3 V VIN (about 3.1-3.2 V after the LDO) is within the chip's range and the model's 3.3 V minimum is correct.
